reviews.title: Piece of Work Company
reviews.text: They charge you to still run ads which I knew of because they tell you ok whatever an Ad or two cool. The stupid movies freeze every 10 minutes with a “something went wrong” causing you to back out click continue watching and guess what? An ad plays every few minutes this happens you can’t even watch the stupid movie! Will be unsubscribing and deleting this piece of work app! Very unhappy and yall can’t be giving a true honest 4.9 star rating with issues like this. Just use another company

reviews.title: Not Ready for iPhone Duo
reviews.text: Please update to use full advantage of the big screen just like every other streaming app

reviews.title: Read the fine print
reviews.text: Our tv is over four years old and therefore incompatible to this app per the customer service help I received. So we tried casting. It worked for about two nights and now won’t work from my phone or my husbands. Very disappointed. The shows we did watched were great and I hate that we are missing out.

reviews.title: I love Angel studios but not the app
reviews.text:
I do love to watch all the movies and shows Angel Studios has to offer.
The app is glitchy and has multiple issues. So I just watch the Angel Studios website and have no issues.
It would be nice to use the app, but it won’t work for my iPad Pro. If they could fix it, it would be great.

reviews.title: App is awful !!!
reviews.text:
I don’t know why you decided to start loading up all the movies and shows with commercials and promos but it is destroying any pleasure of watching and the app to fast forward leaves it skipping backwards and forward.  It’s very annoying and makes me wonder why now?
Any chances you will charge more for no commercials like other platforms?  then I will really be sad.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Downloaded the app due to the selection of movies/shows/etc. Subscribed for the Monthly Sub. And it never let me proceed through with any program. Definitely a bug issue. Maybe if they fix it I would give it a second chance. But waste of time for sure.

reviews.title: Treating customers like stupid pawns
reviews.text: Making people pay to watch commercials. And now I’ve resigned myself to the commercial and it just sits frozen on the commercial with no way to bypass despite opening and closing the app multiple times.

reviews.title: Love Angel, but the app has trouble
reviews.text: I love Angel on the phone and television, but the Apple Vision Pro app never can turn on. Once this gets fixed, it will be fantastic. I love having family friendly options to watch.
